An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''system defense force''' defended the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gandle Ott]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] stripped Gandle Ott of its defense force, adding the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] to his own [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]].
